gloss: the said; the relevant; the ... in question

definitions.gloss: the said; the relevant; the ... in question
definitions.explanation: Placed before a noun to point back to the thing already mentioned or the one concerned, like English "the said" or "the ... in question". A word of official notices, news reports, contracts and regulations, not of conversation.

examples.japanese: {当該|とうがい}⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧。
{当該|とうがい}⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回収|かいしゅう}します→回収する：21142_kaishuusuru⟧。
examples.english: We are recalling the product concerned.

examples.japanese: {当該|とうがい}⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}め→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}している→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧。
examples.english: The employee in question has admitted the facts, and the company is considering disciplinary action.

notes:
Usually joined straight to the noun ({当該|とうがい}⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧), sometimes with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ ({当該|とうがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧). Formal and written.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {当該|とうがい}⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧: the vehicle in question (railway and accident reports)
- {当該|とうがい}⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: the product concerned (recall notices)
- {当該|とうがい}⟦{年度|ねんど}→年度：00309_nendo⟧: the fiscal year in question

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{該当|がいとう}→該当：14177_gaitou⟧: the same two kanji reversed; "falling under, matching" (⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{該当|がいとう}する→該当する：29179_gaitousuru⟧), a different word
